schema_validation: Runtime closed-field parser tested; no independent CDDL validation or protocol interoperability
bootstrap_trust: Fixed CA, expected server hostname, client certificate/private key and witness Ed25519 public key/kid supplied out of band
Deployment namespace fixed by injected StateVault deployment_id
Certificate fingerprints and per-namespace roles provisioned offline; no grant/revoke RPC
Witness signer and TLS private keys are distinct; neither is the storage master key

transport.client_deadline: Monotonic absolute deadline across connect, TLS handshake, send and receive; remaining time applied before each blocking network call
transport.timeout_semantics: Timeout is an unknown commit outcome, not server cancellation; SQLite lock wait and computation may outlast transport deadline
transport.resource_limits: Bounded frame allocation and per-connection network deadlines; no bounded worker pool, rate limiting or total service execution budget

authorization.principal: SHA256 of TLS-verified DER leaf certificate
authorization.write_check: Current grant and revocation checked inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as bootstrap/CAS, before historical retry lookup
authorization.read_check: Permission and head/image read share one SQLite read transaction
authorization.revocation_order: Revocation committed before authorization snapshot denies; an already authorized transaction can finish first. No retroactive erasure of returned data
authorization.certificate_rotation: New certificate means new fingerprint and explicit new grant; no automatic migration
authorization.certificate_trust_limit: Local grant revocation supported; no general CA CRL/OCSP lifecycle

requests.metadata: Restricted deterministic CBOR from wire.py; exact field set per method
requests.challenge: Fresh OS-random 32 bytes for each call, including retries
requests.body_binding: body_size and SHA256(raw body); head request body must be empty
requests.cas: Expected old sequence/digest plus independent random 128-bit request_id; exact same logical retry retains request_id/body/base but gets fresh challenge
requests.body_validation: Witness treats image as bounded opaque bytes; ledger recovery validates canonical full-state structure and contents

responses.signature: COSE_Sign1 with mandatory tag 18, protected alg -19 and pinned kid, empty unprotected map, Ed25519 signature
responses.verification: Pinned signer and kid, closed field set, exact request context, fresh challenge and requester; successful write seq/digest must match requested state; head image must hash to signed digest
responses.freshness_limit: Proves a response belongs to this outstanding request under the honest signer assumption; does not stop a compromised witness signing stale or equivocal heads
responses.rejection: Only allowlisted signed error codes. Invalid framing/TLS/unexpected server failures close connection. No raw exceptions or unauthenticated success

recovery_rules: No TLS, signer, authorization or protocol failure permits plaintext fallback
A CAS may have committed even if response is absent, late, malformed or unverifiable
Local tentative rollback is not a witness rollback and does not restore spent/held authority
Reconcile authenticated current head and recover the accepted exact state before divergent replica resumes
Unavailable authenticated witness blocks progress; never bootstrap from an old local balance
witness_assumptions: Accepted history does not roll back
Linearizable CAS and full image durability
Trusted signer, CA/bootstrap and permission store
Independent fault domain required for production; two local SQLite files do not establish it
remaining: Production CA/key custody, rotation, revocation and workload identities
Independent nonrollback witness deployment and replica consistency
Bounded server resources and lock-free or short-lock remote commit architecture
Incremental authenticated recovery log and performance evaluation
